== English Death Star II comparison ==
Verified Black Border and pre-July-2018 Holotable full images both literally print ‘may subtact’. The older Wiki article alone transcribes ‘may subtract’. Preserve the 2018 digital rendition and its image history outside the two gameplay columns. The 2022 official replacement and current D-E1 make the Y-wing discount mandatory. The legacy PC Errata and PC Errata 2 titles require a guarded consolidation because the first is a same-state rendition; retain the live bare UID and direct anchors. [[:File:Lieutenant-Telsij-PC-image-changes-2022-01-27.png|Published image comparison]]. The article title retains the legacy image ordinal, while the published errata face bears D-E1.
